nodes.speaker: Mara, the gatekeeper
nodes.text: The keep is barred for the night. Goblins are inside, and I cannot risk letting another stranger through.

choices.text: We know what is inside. We will help.
Trust us. We can handle this. [Persuasion DC 12]
We will return in the morning.

nodes.speaker: Mara, the gatekeeper
nodes.text: Then take this key. Bring the people of the keep home safely. I will remember your kindness.

nodes.speaker: Mara, the gatekeeper
nodes.text: Brave words alone will not open this gate. Listen first, and show me you understand the danger.
